fields.description: Jasa = pekerjaan/servis. Part = barang dari gudang (dikeluarkan dari stok saat M&R selesai). Part (Beli Langsung) = barang fisik yang tidak distok — tanpa gudang, tanpa cek stok.
fields.label: Jenis

fields.description: Service or spare part — must have an Item Price in the owner's price list.
fields.label: Item (Service / Part)

fields.description: Gudang asal part ini. Tiap baris boleh beda gudang.
fields.label: Gudang

fields.description: Sisa stok di gudang baris ini. Kosong untuk Jasa.
fields.label: Stok

fields.description: Owner's per-line decision. Only Approved lines are repaired, issued from stock, and billed.
fields.label: Owner Decision

fields.description: Mata uang baris ini, dari Item Price pemilik tank.
fields.label: Currency

fields.description: Per-unit item price from the owner's Item Price (adjustable).
fields.label: Item Rate

fields.description: Auto: Amount Cost Manhour + Amount Item Rate.
fields.label: Total Cost

fields.description: Jam kerja standar item ini (dari master Item). Tidak dikali Qty.
fields.label: Manhour

fields.description: Otomatis: Biaya Manhour ÷ Manhour. Inilah tarif per jam yang dipakai header invoice bila semua baris sepakat.
fields.label: Tarif per Jam (efektif)

fields.description: Biaya labour baris ini. Terisi dari kontrak pemilik tank (Manhour × tarif per jam), boleh diubah. TIDAK masuk Total Cost — ditagih terpisah di header invoice.
fields.label: Biaya Manhour

fields.description: Owner's note on this line (e.g. why it was rejected).
fields.label: Owner Remark

fields.description: Auto: a stock item is issued from the source warehouse on completion.
fields.label: Stock Item
